title: Harborline Servers: Extra IPv4 Address, Snapshot Storage and Reinstall Charges
content:
Beyond the addresses included with each server, the VPS and Dedicated Servers range sells extra IPv4 addresses by the month, up to a ceiling per tier. Snapshot storage is free up to a number of slots and priced per GB-month beyond them, and an operating system reinstall carries a fixed fee.

## Charges by tier

| Tier | Extra IPv4 address, price per address per month (USD) | Most extra IPv4 addresses allowed | Free snapshot slots | Snapshot storage beyond the free slots, price per GB-month (USD) | Operating system reinstall fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline VPS 2 GB | 3.00 | 2 | 1 | 0.05 | 0.00 |
| Harborline VPS 4 GB | 3.00 | 2 | 1 | 0.05 | 0.00 |
| Harborline VPS 8 GB | 3.00 | 4 | 2 | 0.05 | 0.00 |
| Harborline VPS 16 GB | 3.00 | 8 | 2 | 0.05 | 0.00 |
| Harborline Dedicated Standard | 3.00 | 16 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Harborline Dedicated Enterprise | 3.00 | 64 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

The free snapshot slot count is 0 for the dedicated tiers, as the schedule records it.

## Worked readings

- **Ceiling on extra addresses.** A Harborline VPS 4 GB server may carry at most 2 extra IPv4 addresses; a third extra address is beyond the ceiling for that tier. A Harborline VPS 16 GB server may carry up to 8.
- **Monthly price of extra addresses.** Each extra address is priced at 3.00 per month on every tier, so the monthly price of a server's extra addresses is that price multiplied by the number of extra addresses it carries.
- **Snapshot storage.** On the four Harborline VPS tiers, snapshot storage beyond the free slots is priced at 0.05 per GB-month; on the two Harborline Dedicated tiers there are no free slots and the price shown is 0.00.
- **Reinstall.** The reinstall fee is 0.00 on every tier.
